subject: TBL
body: In Tableau, blue fields are
explanation: Green fields are continuous.

subject: TBL
body: Dimensions in Tableau usually contain
options: qualitative values like names, dates or categories
explanation: Measures contain quantitative values that are aggregated.

subject: TBL
body: Which LOD expression computes a value at a specified level regardless of the view?
explanation: INCLUDE and EXCLUDE adjust relative to the view's level.

subject: TBL
body: Table calculations such as running total are computed
options: on the data already in the view
explanation: Change 'Compute Using' to control direction.

subject: TBL
body: Which Tableau filter is applied first in the order of operations?
explanation: Then data source, context, dimension, measure and table calc filters.

subject: TBL
body: Context filters are used to
options: create an independent filter that other filters depend on
explanation: They also feed Top N and FIXED calculations.

subject: TBL
body: A Tableau extract (.hyper) is
options: a saved snapshot of data for fast performance
explanation: Live connections query the source directly.

subject: TBL
body: Relationships (the 'noodle') in Tableau's data model differ from joins because they
options: keep tables separate and combine them at the right level for each view
explanation: Joins merge tables into one before analysis.

subject: TBL
body: Data blending combines data
options: from different sources at the aggregated level, using a primary and secondary source
explanation: Linking fields connect the sources.

subject: TBL
body: The Marks card controls
options: colour, size, label, detail and tooltip for the marks in a view
explanation: It is central to building visuals.

subject: TBL
body: Which chart type compares a measure against a target with bars?
explanation: Show Me suggests charts based on your fields.

subject: TBL
body: Dashboard actions let users
options: filter or highlight other views by interacting with one view
explanation: Filter, highlight, URL, parameter and set actions exist.

subject: TBL
body: The Tableau Desktop Specialist exam has
explanation: It is an entry-level certification.

subject: TBL
body: Dragging a continuous date to Columns creates
explanation: A discrete date creates headers.

subject: TBL
body: A dimension placed on the Detail mark
options: splits the marks without changing colour or size
explanation: It increases the level of detail.

subject: TBL
body: Which function returns the running total of SUM(Sales) along the table?
explanation: It is a table calculation.

subject: TBL
body: Which function ranks values in the view?
explanation: RANK_DENSE and RANK_UNIQUE are variants.

subject: TBL
body: {INCLUDE [Customer] : SUM([Sales])} computes
options: a value at a finer level (including Customer), then aggregates it to the view
explanation: EXCLUDE removes a dimension from the view's level.

subject: TBL
body: A calculated field using IF [Profit] > 0 THEN "Profit" ELSE "Loss" END returns
options: a string category for each row
explanation: It can be used on Colour.

subject: TBL
body: ZN([Sales]) returns
options: 0 when Sales is null, otherwise Sales
explanation: Useful for filling gaps in calculations.

subject: TBL
body: A parameter in Tableau is
options: a user-controlled value that can drive calculations, filters or reference lines
explanation: Show the parameter control to let users change it.

subject: TBL
body: A set in Tableau is
options: a custom group of members of a dimension defined by conditions or selection
explanation: Sets show IN/OUT membership.

subject: TBL
body: Grouping combines
options: several dimension members into a higher-level category
explanation: For example grouping small countries into 'Other'.

subject: TBL
body: Dual axis lets you
options: show two measures with separate axes in one chart
explanation: Synchronise axes when the scales match.

subject: TBL
body: Reference lines are used to
options: show averages, targets or constants on an axis
explanation: Bands and distributions are similar options.

subject: TBL
body: Which chart best shows the relationship between two measures for many items?
explanation: Add a trend line to show correlation.

subject: TBL
body: A dashboard's 'Fixed' size is useful because
options: the layout looks the same on every screen
explanation: Automatic size can rearrange or crop content.

subject: TBL
body: Tableau Public workbooks are
options: saved publicly and visible to anyone
explanation: Use Tableau Cloud or Server for private sharing.

subject: TBL
body: When a data source has a field stored as text but containing numbers, you should
options: change its data type to number
explanation: Correct types let Tableau aggregate properly.

subject: TBL
body: A left join between Orders and Returns keeps
options: all orders, with return details where they exist
explanation: Unmatched returns columns are null.
